body:
Layer 4's `batchClaims` and the Layer 10 claim pool need zero-based weighted batching and an actual game that fixes claims before its fresh challenge. This claims only that prerequisite subset of [#12](https://github.com/Verified-zkEVM/leanerVM/issues/12), ledger A6.

Algebra: `powerBatch`, `batchWeight`, `pairing_batchWeight`, `batch_complete`, `batchDifference`, `coeff_batchDifference`, `batchDifference_ne_zero`, `eval_batchDifference`, `natDegree_batchDifference_le`, `singleton_batch_ne`, `empty_powerBatch`, `card_false_batch_le`, `uniform_false_batch_fraction_le`. Operational consumer: `PowerBatchTranscript`, `runBatchingRound`, `FalseBatchAccepted`, `runBatchingRound_false_accept_le`, `runBatchingRound_honest`.

P05 depends only on #18's multilinear API. The game depends on P05, not the block-claim branch. Category A: leanVM `a386121f`, §4.1 and `cor:idtest`; scalar source: leanth `23929f8c`, `ProofSystem/ZeroCheck.lean:670-697`, with its notice retained. Actual powers start at zero.

The sumcheck consumer is tracked by [ArkLib #3](https://github.com/Verified-zkEVM/ArkLib/issues/3). Open [#615](https://github.com/Verified-zkEVM/ArkLib/pull/615) already has the matching scalar separation contract in `BatchingStrategy.gammaPowers`; converge onto it after its module/probability API and pin are adopted. The CompPoly weight-table pairing and arbitrary-prefix game are separate consumers, not a claim that the scalar bound is absent upstream.

Acceptance: false-family degree at most `J - 1`, zero challenge, empty/singleton cases, cancellation, and a challenge-first false family accepted with probability one. Require direct-import clients, focused tests, `./scripts/validate.sh`, and standard-only transitive axioms. No batching knowledge theorem, VM power assignment or transcript correspondence is claimed.
title: [Intention]: protocol - Layer 4: zero-based batching and its fresh-challenge game
